name: SourceExcelApplication
label: Source Excel Application
description: The Excel Application object containing the source worksheet.

name: CopyMode
label: Copy Mode
description: Specifies how to identify the source worksheet: by Name or Index.

selectOptions.label: Name
selectOptions.description: Copies the worksheet by its name.

selectOptions.label: Index
selectOptions.description: Copies the worksheet by its index.

name: WorksheetName
label: Worksheet Name
description: The name of the worksheet to copy (required if 'Copy Mode' is 'Name').

name: WorksheetIndex
label: Worksheet Index
description: The index of the worksheet to copy (required if 'Copy Mode' is 'Index').

name: TargetExcelApplication
label: Target Excel Application
description: The Excel Application object where the worksheet will be copied.

name: PastePosition
label: Paste Position
description: Specifies where to paste the copied worksheet in the target workbook.

selectOptions.label: First worksheet
selectOptions.description: Pastes the worksheet as the first sheet in the target workbook.

selectOptions.label: Last worksheet
selectOptions.description: Pastes the worksheet as the last sheet in the target workbook.
